definitions.explanation: A person in charge of directing military operations or leading an organized group. Also used for the leader of a rescue team, fire brigade, or similar unit.

examples.japanese: {指揮官|しきかん}が{命令|めいれい}を{出|だ}した。
{現場|げんば}の{指揮官|しきかん}が{救助|きゅうじょ}{活動|かつどう}を{指揮|しき}した。
examples.english: The on-site commander directed the rescue operation.

examples.japanese: {優|すぐ}れた{指揮官|しきかん}は{部下|ぶか}の{信頼|しんらい}を{得|え}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: A good commander must earn the trust of their subordinates.

notes:
Compound of {指揮|しき} (command/direction) + {官|かん} (officer/official).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高|さいこう}{指揮官|しきかん}: supreme commander
- {現場|げんば}{指揮官|しきかん}: field/on-site commander
- {指揮官|しきかん}が{命令|めいれい}を{出|だ}す: the commander issues an order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {司令官|しれいかん}: commander-in-chief (higher rank, overall command)
- {隊長|たいちょう}: unit leader, captain (smaller unit)
- {指揮|しき}{者|しゃ}: director, conductor (also used for orchestra conductors)

USAGE:
While primarily military, {指揮官|しきかん} is also used in non-military contexts such as disaster response, firefighting, and rescue operations.
